changelog: **Terminology card on /admin/settings (#1629):** `TerminologyCard` edits the org's `terminology` setting per language — one row per catalogued noun, four forms each, a half-filled row refused in the browser, "back to the defaults" clears the layer — and refreshes the page so the new words take over. Rows are labelled from `TERM_DEFAULTS`, never the dictionary. Shown and accepted (`PUT /api/admin/terminology` → `requireCapability('mentorship')`) only where the vertical has `mentorship`. Feature catalogue entry `terminology`.

en: Use your own words: rename mentors, mentees, programmes, cohorts and mentorships per language in Settings — menus, screens and e-mails follow.
tr: Kendi kelimelerinizi kullanın: Ayarlar'da mentor, mentee, program, kohort ve mentorluk adlarını her dil için değiştirin — menüler, ekranlar ve e-postalar da değişir.
de: Eigene Begriffe: Benennen Sie Mentoren, Mentees, Programme, Kohorten und Mentorings in den Einstellungen je Sprache um — Menüs, Seiten und E-Mails übernehmen es.
